functions.name: add_tee_signer
functions.doc:
Admin only: accept decisions signed by this enclave key (32-byte ed25519). The admin takes it from the
 NEAR AI Cloud attestation report after verifying the report off chain.

type_schema.description:
NEAR Account Identifier.

This is a unique, syntactically valid, human-readable account identifier on the NEAR network.

[See the crate-level docs for information about validation.](index.html#account-id-rules)

Also see [Error kind precedence](AccountId#error-kind-precedence).

## Examples

``` use near_account_id::AccountId;

let alice: AccountId = "alice.near".parse().unwrap();

assert!("ƒelicia.near".parse::<AccountId>().is_err()); // (ƒ is not f) ```

functions.name: is_decision_used
functions.doc: Whether the decision with this `proof_hash` (sha256 of request hash ‖ response hash) has paid.

functions.name: on_signed
functions.doc:
The MPC answer. On success logs `event` (the `payment_signed` event of a payment) and returns the
 signature; on failure gives `value` back to `owner`'s allowance, frees the decision and returns null.

functions.name: open_account
functions.doc:
Open the caller's account. The caller becomes its owner; its key is derived with the caller's account id
 as path, and `payer` is the address of that key. The deposit (at least 0.01 NEAR, all of it kept) pays
 for the account's storage.

functions.name: payment_digest_hex
functions.doc: The EIP-712 digest `sign_payment` would sign for these fields, so a client can check its own encoding.

functions.name: remove_tee_signer
functions.doc: Admin only: stop accepting decisions signed by this enclave key.

functions.name: revoke
functions.doc: Owner only: stop all signing for the caller's account.

functions.name: set_policy
functions.doc: Owner only: replace the policy. The owner signs this with its own key, which the agent does not have.

functions.name: sign_login
functions.doc:
Sign a sign-in message (EIP-191 `personal_sign`) as `owner`'s payer, so a shop can show the buyer its
 orders. Only a message that opens with the sign-in line of a domain in the policy is signed. Such a digest
 starts from the "\x19Ethereum Signed Message" prefix, so it can never be a payment authorization (0x1901).

functions.name: sign_payment
functions.doc:
Sign one EIP-3009 `transferWithAuthorization` from `owner`'s payer to `to`, if `decision` is a fresh
 decision of a policy model signed by a listed enclave and the payment fits the policy.
 Returns the MPC signature (`big_r`, `s`, `recovery_id`), or null when the MPC network did not sign,
 in which case the allowance and the decision are restored. A request outside the policy fails the
 transaction.

agent.description: The only account that may ask for a signature.

allowance.description: Token base units still spendable in total. Each signature reduces it.

allowed_payees.description: Addresses that may be paid, 20 bytes hex with 0x.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds after which nothing is signed.

login_domains.description: Sites the payer address may sign in to (`sign_login`), e.g. "api.bitrefill.com".

models.description: NEAR AI Cloud model ids whose enclave decisions may pay, e.g. "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017".

per_payment_cap.description: Most token base units one payment may move.

TeeProof.description: The NEAR AI Cloud signature record for one completion (same shape as the arena's `TeeProof`). The model's enclave signs the raw text `"{model_id}:{request_hash_hex}:{response_hash_hex}"` with ed25519. Only kind 2 (`provider_tee`, the model's own enclave) is accepted here.

request_hash.description: sha256 of the exact request body bytes.

response_hash.description: sha256 of the exact response body bytes.

Token.description: The EIP-712 domain of the token contract.

name.description: `name()` of the token as its EIP-712 domain uses it, e.g. "USD Coin".
